verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop OS, so proximity-based device setup is a fair question for it. The pack documents only a USB ISO installer with five questions and unattended installs. Nothing describes pairing a personal device or using its proximity to configure a new machine, and the LocalSend firewall port is a separate file-sharing feature, not a setup flow.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can set up a new machine quickly by bringing a paired personal device near it
